name: Initialize API
description: Initialize the API client with a base URL.
usage:
import { getApi } from 'es-fetch-api';
const api = getApi('https://api.example.com');

name: GET Request with Query Params
description: Send a GET request with query parameters.

name: POST JSON Request
description: Send a POST request with a JSON body.

name: POST Form Request
description: Send a POST request with form data (application/x-www-form-urlencoded).

name: File Upload
Custom Headers
description: Add custom headers to the request.
usage:
import { header } from 'es-fetch-api/middlewares/header.js';

await api('/protected', header({ 'Authorization': 'Bearer token' }));

name: Specific HTTP Method
description: Force a specific HTTP method (e.g., DELETE, PUT).

description: Make a request abortable using AbortController.
